nodes.title: SG-2.2 Author the boy sheet and portrait
nodes.body:
Context: the art pipeline (draw helpers, ArtSource, generateAssets, art:generate) exists and the room grids are authored (SG-2.1). Boy art is still SVG. Desired behavior: palette-indexed grids for the boy and portrait are authored, generated to PNG by art:generate, and the manifest declares the animations with frame ranges and rates. Expected result: PNGs at declared sizes using only palette colours. Why: replaces placeholder character art. Switching content to PNGs is SG-2.3, not this intent.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the boy sheet source, when generated, then the PNG is 448x48 holding 14 frames of 32x48
- Given the manifest, when read, then idle, walk and interact declare frame ranges 0-3, 4-9 and 10-13 with frame rates
- Given the portrait source, when generated, then the PNG is 32x32 and uses only palette colours


## Scope
- In scope: boy sheet grids
- In scope: portrait grid
- In scope: animation and origin support in generated manifest entries
- In scope: unit tests for frame counts and size
- Out of scope: switching world content to PNGs
- Out of scope: deleting SVGs
- Out of scope: BootScene animation registration changes
- Out of scope: new rooms, audio, backend
- Preserve: existing character:boy, boy-walk and boy-interact SVG entries
- Preserve: Phaser 3.90.x pin
- Preserve: 480x270 native resolution
- Preserve: shared 48-colour palette


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
- All art is raster pixel art generated in-repo from source data by a deterministic script; no downloaded art
- One shared palette of at most 48 colours
- Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked


## Definition of done
- All requirements met with Act and Verify units green


## Non-functional requirements
- Generation is deterministic


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Boy sheet grids hold 14 frames of 32x48 with outlines and ramp shading
nodes.body:
Context: ArtSource frames are palette-index grids; draw.ts offers createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, dither, rampIndex. Desired: a boy in a blue hoodie with indigo outline drawn per frame. Expected: one ArtSource with 14 frames of 32 wide, 48 high. Why: the visual target requires an animated boy.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BOY_SOURCES, when the sheet source is read, then it has exactly 14 frames each 48 rows by 32 columns
- Given any frame, when its indices are checked, then every index is below PALETTE.length
- Given idle, walk and interact frames, when compared, then frames within an animation differ from each other


## Scope
- In scope: src/art/boy.ts sheet grids
- Out of scope: portrait
- Out of scope: manifest
- Preserve: draw.ts helpers unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Shared palette of at most 48 colours
- Deterministic pure drawing functions


## Definition of done
- boy sheet source exported


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Generated manifest declares boy animations with frame ranges and rates
nodes.body:
Context: generateAssets emits image or spritesheet entries without animations or origin, and mergeManifest replaces by id. ART_SOURCES holds only the cursor. Desired: ArtSource optionally carries animations and origin, generateAssets copies them, and ART_SOURCES includes the boy sources so npm run art:generate writes PNGs and manifest entries. Expected: manifest has character:boy-art (448x48, idle 0-3, walk 4-9, interact 10-13) and character:boy-portrait (32x32). Why: Done-when requires the manifest to declare animations.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a source with animations and origin, when generateAssets runs, then the entry includes them unchanged
- Given the committed manifest, when parsed with parseManifest, then it is valid and idle, walk, interact have frames [0-3], [4-9], [10-13] with frameRates
- Given ART_SOURCES, when listed, then it contains the boy sheet and portrait ids


## Scope
- In scope: ArtSource fields
- In scope: generateAssets
- In scope: ART_SOURCES
- In scope: manifest.json regeneration
- Out of scope: content switching to PNG
- Out of scope: SVG removal
- Preserve: existing manifest entries and SVG paths
- Preserve: deterministic output
- Preserve: sources without animations behave as before


## Technical constraints
- Deterministic generation script; no downloaded art
- Keep data-driven content; no ids hardcoded in scenes


## Dependencies
- R1
- R2


## Definition of done
- npm run art:generate produces PNGs and a valid manifest


## Non-functional requirements
- Identical bytes on repeated runs


## Clarifying questions
- None
